board.name: Uttarakhand Board of School Education (Uttarakhand Vidyalayi Shiksha Parishad), Ramnagar
board.summary: The Uttarakhand Board of School Education, at Ramnagar in Nainital district, conducts the High School (Class 10) and Intermediate (Class 12) examinations. It grew out of a regional office of the Uttar Pradesh board set up at Ramnagar in 1996, and the present council was constituted by a government order of 11 December 2008. Its site publishes syllabi, paper designs, question banks, model answer sheets, and improvement and scrutiny processes. A Class 10 or 12 candidate takes the board examination in the subjects passed in Class 9 or 11.

intro: NXTutors does not yet have a city tuition-jobs page anywhere in Uttarakhand, so this state page is where tutors here start, whether you live in Dehradun, Haridwar, Roorkee, Haldwani or a hill town. Write your town and the localities you can reach. When a family asks for home lessons, the request goes to the nearest suitable tutors first, then further out, so a clear base is what puts you in line for a student nearby. Online lessons are not tied to place at all and are matched by subject, class and board, so you can start teaching before a nearby family has asked.

Uttarakhand students may be on the state board at Ramnagar, CBSE, ICSE or another board, in Hindi or English medium. List every board and medium you teach. The board's own site carries its High School and Intermediate syllabi, paper designs and question banks, which are the right place to check before a demo. Each request ends with two or three tutors for the parent to compare; your fee, set by you, is visible before a free first class, and families can switch later. Intermediate tutors should name their stream and subjects too.

faqs: There is no Dehradun tuition-jobs page. Can I still join?
Yes. Join from this state page with Dehradun as your town and list the localities you can reach. A family near you is offered nearby tutors first, and online students are open to you from the start.
Can a Class 12 student change subjects from Class 11?

Not for the board examination. The board's site says a candidate applies for the Class 10 and 12 examinations in the same subjects passed in Class 9 and Class 11. That is useful to know when a family asks about subject choices.
How does a family's request reach a tutor?

A parent sends class, board, subject and location. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, nearest first, then wider, then online. The family sees each fee, has a free first class, and can switch later at no charge.
